controls.help: Preview, accept, cancel, undo, and redo rigid transforms of multi-tile donor groups.

controls.label: Preview group transform

controls.help: Compute a non-destructive preview of a donor group transform.

controls.label: Accept group transform
controls.region: Right sidebar > Archaeology > Phase layers > Donor group transform
controls.help: Commit the valid preview to the layer and add it to undo history.

controls.label: Cancel transform preview
controls.region: Right sidebar > Archaeology > Phase layers > Donor group transform
controls.help: Discard the preview without changing the layer or donor source.

controls.label: Undo group transform
controls.region: Right sidebar > Archaeology > Phase layers > Donor group transform
controls.help: Restore the previous accepted group placement.

controls.label: Redo group transform
controls.region: Right sidebar > Archaeology > Phase layers > Donor group transform
controls.help: Reapply the most recently undone group placement.

controls.label: Manual object placement
controls.region: Right sidebar > PM4 > Live Alignment > Manual Curation
controls.help: Move and yaw-adjust a selected object in the live scene, then record its curation snapshot without writing source map files.

controls.label: Apply manual position
controls.region: Right sidebar > PM4 > Manual object placement
controls.help: Apply the selected object's edited world position to the live scene and curation snapshot.

controls.label: Apply manual yaw
controls.region: Right sidebar > PM4 > Manual object placement
controls.help: Apply an arbitrary yaw to the selected object in the live scene and curation snapshot.

controls.label: Record selected placement
controls.region: Right sidebar > PM4 > Manual object placement
controls.help: Add or refresh the selected tile-scoped object snapshot in the manual curation project.

controls.label: Manual object to PM4 hull curation
controls.help: Create, inspect, explicitly replace, or remove user-authored object-to-hull associations.

controls.label: Pair selected object with hull
controls.region: Right sidebar > PM4 > Manual object to PM4 hull curation
controls.help: Create an explicit association between the selected object placement and selected PM4 hull.

controls.label: Replace with selected hull
controls.region: Right sidebar > PM4 > Manual object to PM4 hull curation
controls.help: Explicitly replace this object's current hull association with the selected hull.

controls.label: Remove association
controls.region: Right sidebar > PM4 > Manual object to PM4 hull curation
controls.help: Remove this explicit curation association without deleting either member.

controls.label: Save manual curation project
controls.region: Right sidebar > PM4 > Manual object to PM4 hull curation
controls.help: Save curated placements and PM4 hull associations to a separate project file, not source map files.

controls.label: Reload manual curation project
controls.region: Right sidebar > PM4 > Manual object to PM4 hull curation
controls.help: Reload saved curation-only placement snapshots and explicit PM4 associations.

controls.label: Place selected catalog model on hull tile
controls.region: Right sidebar > PM4 > Manual object to PM4 hull curation
controls.help: Create a curation-only placement at the selected hull tile using the current client Asset Catalog entry.

controls.label: Pair saved placement with selected hull
controls.region: Right sidebar > PM4 > Manual object to PM4 hull curation
controls.help: Explicitly associate an already recorded manual placement with the selected PM4 hull.
